svg.title: Desktop shell · Electron security and the save bridge
svg.desc: The page has no Node access; the only way out is saveFile, and the main process re-checks every request before the native Save dialog.
svg.text: Desktop shell · Electron security and the save bridge
The page has no Node access; the only way out is saveFile, and the main process re-checks every request before the native Save dialog.
